decision: 1 (corrected) - the three-state-colour candidate, as a new candidate
reserve_caveat: This is the SECOND read of these six sets; the first was the buggy-colour candidate, archived at results/decision-1/. A twice-read holdout is weaker than a fresh one. There are no spare sets to replace it: mid, stx and vow lack the win-rate and games-bucket columns the cohort selection needs. The protocol's strength is correspondingly reduced and that is not repaired by the result having come out the same way.
what_changed_since_the_first_pass: card_colours now returns None for a card with too few decks to judge, instead of an empty frozenset that commitment() read as colourless and credited with the whole pool. Unknown declines the colour judgement everywhere it appears.

companion_results.same_population_v2_baseline: v2 at W=0 on the identical 24-set validation population reads r = -0.06500 against v3's -0.07125. NOT tested on this population: v2 at the heavy weights (W>=1000) where it previously won, so 'v3 alone beats v2 plus its best blend' remains unestablished here.
